findings.suggested: ... صرف لاطینی حروف، ہندسے (0-9)، ... (or 'لاطینی حروف اور ہندسے' throughout)
findings.reason: Urdu keyboards type ۰-۹ digits, which the pattern rejects; 'ہندسے' alone does not exclude them. English has the same gap, so it is optional.
